title: Korean Bibimbap
summary: Warm rice topped with colourful sautéed vegetables, a fried egg and punchy gochujang sauce.

stages.title: Cook the rice
steps: Rinse rice until water runs mostly clear and cook with the appropriate amount of water.
Leave covered for five minutes after cooking to let the grains settle.

stages.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps: Blanch spinach briefly, squeeze dry and dress with a little sesame oil.
Sauté carrots, mushrooms and courgette separately until just tender, seasoning lightly.

stages.title: Make sauce and eggs
steps: Mix gochujang with soy sauce, sugar and a splash of water until spoonable.
Fry eggs sunny-side up so the whites set and yolks remain soft.

stages.title: Assemble bowls
steps: Divide warm rice between four bowls and arrange vegetables in distinct sections.
Top with eggs, drizzle with sauce and mix everything thoroughly before eating.

tips: Keep vegetable toppings separate for colour and texture.
variations: Add thinly sliced cooked beef or use tofu.
storage: Refrigerate components separately up to 2 days; reheat rice thoroughly.

title: Indian Masala Dosa
summary: Crisp fermented rice-and-lentil crêpes wrapped around turmeric-spiced potatoes and mustard seeds.

stages.title: Cook potato filling
steps: Boil potatoes until tender, drain and roughly crush with a fork.
Keep a little texture rather than mashing them completely smooth.

stages.title: Temper the spices
steps: Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds until they begin to pop.
Add curry leaves, chilli and onion and cook until softened, then stir in turmeric.

stages.title: Combine the masala
steps: Fold potatoes into the spiced onion mixture with a splash of water.
Season with salt and lemon juice and keep warm.

stages.title: Cook and fill dosas
steps: Heat a flat non-stick pan and spread a thin ladleful of dosa batter in outward circles.
Drizzle the edges with oil, cook until crisp and golden, then add filling and fold.

tips: Use properly fermented dosa batter for the best crispness.
variations: Add peas to the potato filling.
storage: Refrigerate filling up to 3 days; cook dosas fresh.

title: Vietnamese Pho Ga
summary: Fragrant chicken noodle soup with ginger, star anise, rice noodles and fresh herbs.

stages.title: Char the aromatics
steps: Char halved onion and ginger in a dry pan until fragrant and lightly blackened.
Rinse off loose burnt bits and place in a large pot with spices.

stages.title: Simmer the broth
steps: Add chicken and water and bring just to a gentle simmer, skimming foam.
Cook until chicken is fully cooked, then remove it and continue steeping the broth briefly.

stages.title: Shred and strain
steps: Cool chicken enough to handle, remove bones and shred the meat.
Strain broth and season gradually with fish sauce and salt.

stages.title: Assemble bowls
steps: Soak or cook rice noodles according to the packet and divide into bowls.
Top with chicken and hot broth, then add spring onions, herbs and lime.

tips: Avoid a rolling boil for a clearer broth.
variations: Add bean sprouts and sliced chilli at the table.
storage: Refrigerate broth and chicken up to 3 days; store noodles separately.

title: Moroccan Harira
summary: Hearty tomato soup with lentils, chickpeas, celery, warming spices and fresh coriander.

stages.title: Soften the vegetables
steps: Cook onion and celery in olive oil until soft and fragrant.
Stir in ginger, turmeric and cinnamon for one minute.

stages.title: Simmer legumes
steps: Add tomatoes, rinsed lentils and stock and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook until lentils are almost tender, then add drained chickpeas.

stages.title: Thicken the soup
steps: Whisk flour with cold water to make a smooth slurry.
Stir gradually into simmering soup and cook until lightly thickened.

stages.title: Finish with herbs
steps: Add chopped coriander and adjust salt and lemon if desired.
Serve hot with bread or dates on the side.

tips: Add flour slurry gradually to avoid lumps.
variations: Add small pieces of lamb for a meat version.
storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days; freeze up to 2 months.

title: American Eggs Benedict
summary: Toasted English muffins layered with ham, poached eggs and buttery lemon hollandaise.

stages.title: Prepare hollandaise
steps: Melt butter and let it cool slightly while whisking egg yolks with lemon over gentle heat.
Slowly whisk in warm butter until thick and silky, keeping the mixture below a simmer.

stages.title: Toast and warm ham
steps: Split and toast muffins until golden at the edges.
Warm ham in a dry skillet and arrange on muffin halves.

stages.title: Poach the eggs
steps: Bring a wide pan of water to a bare simmer and add vinegar.
Crack eggs into small cups and slide into water, cooking until whites set and yolks remain soft.

stages.title: Assemble immediately
steps: Lift eggs out with a slotted spoon and blot excess water.
Place on ham, spoon over hollandaise and finish with cayenne.

tips: Keep hollandaise warm, not hot, to avoid splitting.
variations: Use smoked salmon instead of ham.
storage: Best eaten immediately; do not store assembled eggs Benedict.

title: Italian Cacio e Pepe
summary: Silky spaghetti coated in Pecorino Romano, freshly cracked black pepper and starchy pasta water.

stages.title: Toast the pepper
steps: Crush peppercorns coarsely and toast briefly in a wide dry pan.
Add a ladle of hot pasta water to release their aroma.

stages.title: Cook pasta
steps: Boil spaghetti in lightly salted water until just shy of al dente.
Reserve at least two cups of starchy cooking water before draining.

stages.title: Make cheese paste
steps: Mix finely grated Pecorino with a little warm, not boiling, pasta water.
Stir until a thick smooth paste forms without clumping.

stages.title: Emulsify and serve
steps: Toss pasta in pepper water off the heat, then stir in cheese paste gradually.
Add small splashes of pasta water until glossy and creamy; serve immediately.

tips: Keep cheese away from direct heat to prevent clumps.
variations: Use tonnarelli instead of spaghetti.
storage: Best eaten fresh; leftovers can become grainy.

title: Chinese Dan Dan Noodles
summary: Wheat noodles tossed in chilli oil, sesame paste and savoury pork with Sichuan pepper.

stages.title: Mix the sauce
steps: Whisk sesame paste, soy sauce, vinegar and chilli oil with warm water.
Adjust until smooth and pourable, then divide between bowls.

stages.title: Brown the pork
steps: Fry pork mince in a hot pan, breaking it into small crumbles.
Add garlic and Sichuan pepper and cook until fragrant and pork is fully cooked.

stages.title: Cook noodles
steps: Boil noodles according to their packet until springy and tender.
Reserve a little noodle water and drain well.

stages.title: Toss and serve
steps: Add noodles to sauce bowls and spoon over hot pork.
Toss thoroughly, loosening with noodle water and topping with spring onions.

tips: Use Chinese sesame paste for a robust toasted flavour.
variations: Swap pork for finely chopped mushrooms.
storage: Refrigerate pork topping up to 3 days; cook noodles fresh.

title: Lebanese Fattoush
summary: Crunchy toasted pita tossed with cucumber, tomatoes, herbs and tangy sumac-lemon dressing.

stages.title: Toast the pita
steps: Tear pita into bite-sized pieces and brush lightly with olive oil.
Bake at 190°C until golden and crisp, then cool.

stages.title: Chop vegetables
steps: Cut cucumber, tomatoes and radishes into small chunks.
Wash and dry lettuce thoroughly and roughly chop the herbs.

stages.title: Whisk dressing
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, sumac and salt until combined.
Taste for a bright, tangy balance.

stages.title: Toss at the last minute
steps: Combine vegetables and herbs in a large bowl and coat lightly with dressing.
Fold through toasted pita just before serving so it stays crunchy.

tips: Dry lettuce well so dressing clings.
variations: Add pomegranate seeds in season.
storage: Refrigerate vegetables and dressing separately up to 2 days; add pita fresh.

title: Japanese Onigiri
summary: Hand-shaped seasoned rice triangles with savoury tuna filling, wrapped in crisp nori.

stages.title: Cook sticky rice
steps: Rinse rice until water is mostly clear and cook according to packet directions.
Rest covered for ten minutes, then fluff gently.

stages.title: Prepare the filling
steps: Mix drained tuna with mayonnaise and soy sauce.
Taste and keep the filling fairly thick so it does not leak.

stages.title: Shape the rice
steps: Wet hands with clean water and lightly salt palms.
Flatten a handful of warm rice, add filling and enclose it, shaping into a firm triangle.

stages.title: Wrap and serve
steps: Wrap each triangle with a strip of nori just before eating.
Serve at room temperature soon after preparation.

tips: Use warm, not hot, rice for easier shaping.
variations: Fill with cooked salmon flakes or pickled plum.
storage: Eat promptly; refrigerate up to 1 day and keep chilled.

title: Thai Som Tam
summary: Crunchy green papaya salad pounded with lime, fish sauce, chilli, peanuts and tomatoes.

stages.title: Prepare vegetables
steps: Peel and shred firm green papaya into thin strands.
Cut beans into short lengths and halve cherry tomatoes.

stages.title: Pound aromatics
steps: Lightly pound garlic and chilli in a mortar to release their fragrance.
Add palm sugar, fish sauce and lime juice and mix until dissolved.

stages.title: Bruise the salad
steps: Add beans and tomatoes and gently pound just enough to crack their surfaces.
Fold in shredded papaya, tossing with a spoon between gentle presses.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Add roasted peanuts and toss to coat everything evenly.
Taste for a lively balance of sour, salty, sweet and spicy.

tips: Do not pound papaya into mush; keep it crunchy.
variations: Use shredded carrot if green papaya is unavailable.
storage: Best eaten fresh; refrigerate without peanuts up to 1 day.

title: Spanish Patatas Bravas
summary: Crisp golden potato cubes served with smoky tomato-chilli bravas sauce and optional garlic aioli.

stages.title: Parboil potatoes
steps: Cut potatoes into even cubes and simmer in salted water until barely tender.
Drain thoroughly and steam-dry for several minutes.

stages.title: Roast until crisp
steps: Toss potatoes with oil and salt and spread on a preheated tray.
Roast at 220°C, turning once, until deeply golden and crunchy.

stages.title: Cook bravas sauce
steps: Gently fry garlic with smoked paprika and chilli for a few seconds.
Add passata, vinegar and sugar and simmer until thickened.

stages.title: Serve with sauce
steps: Season potatoes while hot and transfer to a serving dish.
Spoon sauce over some of the potatoes, leaving others crisp.

tips: Dry potatoes thoroughly before roasting.
variations: Serve with garlic aioli.
storage: Refrigerate sauce up to 4 days; potatoes are best fresh.

title: French Quiche Lorraine
summary: Buttery pastry filled with smoky bacon and a silky egg-and-cream custard.

stages.title: Blind-bake the crust
steps: Line a tart tin with pastry, prick the base and chill briefly.
Bake with baking weights at 190°C for 15 minutes, then remove weights and bake five more.

stages.title: Cook the bacon
steps: Fry bacon lardons until lightly crisp and drain excess fat.
Spread evenly over the partially baked pastry shell.

stages.title: Mix the custard
steps: Whisk eggs, cream, milk, nutmeg and black pepper until smooth.
Pour gently over bacon and scatter cheese if using.

stages.title: Bake and rest
steps: Bake at 170°C until edges are set and centre has a slight wobble.
Rest at least ten minutes before slicing.

tips: Do not overbake; custard firms as it cools.
variations: Add sautéed leeks for a variation.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days; reheat gently.

title: Mexican Chilaquiles Rojos
summary: Crisp tortilla chips lightly coated in smoky red salsa, topped with eggs, crema and cheese.

stages.title: Crisp the tortillas
steps: Cut tortillas into triangles, toss with oil and bake at 200°C until crisp.
Cool on a rack while preparing the sauce.

stages.title: Blend the salsa
steps: Soak dried chilli in hot water until soft and remove seeds.
Blend with tomatoes, onion and garlic until smooth.

stages.title: Simmer and combine
steps: Cook blended salsa in a skillet until slightly thickened and fragrant.
Fold tortilla chips through briefly, leaving some edges crunchy.

stages.title: Top and serve
steps: Fry eggs to your liking and place over sauced tortillas.
Finish with crema, crumbled cheese and sliced onion.

tips: Add chips just before serving for contrasting textures.
variations: Use salsa verde instead of red salsa.
storage: Best eaten immediately; refrigerate salsa up to 3 days.

title: Indian Kheer
summary: Creamy cardamom-scented rice pudding simmered slowly in milk with nuts and saffron.

stages.title: Rinse and soak rice
steps: Rinse rice until the water is mostly clear and soak briefly.
Crush cardamom pods lightly to expose their seeds.

stages.title: Simmer in milk
steps: Bring milk to a gentle simmer in a heavy pot and add drained rice and cardamom.
Stir frequently over low heat until grains soften and milk reduces.

stages.title: Sweeten and flavour
steps: Add sugar and saffron and simmer until creamy and lightly thickened.
Stir in rose water off the heat and remove cardamom husks if preferred.

stages.title: Garnish and serve
steps: Toast chopped pistachios and almonds lightly in a dry pan.
Spoon kheer into bowls and scatter nuts over the top.

tips: Stir often to prevent milk catching on the base.
variations: Replace rose water with vanilla.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days; stir in milk when reheating.

title: Italian Panzanella
summary: Juicy summer tomatoes and toasted bread tossed with cucumber, basil and red wine vinaigrette.

stages.title: Prepare bread
steps: Tear day-old bread into rustic pieces and toast lightly if very soft.
Allow to cool so it absorbs dressing without disintegrating.

stages.title: Salt tomatoes
steps: Chop tomatoes and toss with a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Let stand until they release their juices, saving all the liquid.

stages.title: Make vinaigrette
steps: Whisk olive oil, vinegar and grated garlic into tomato juices.
Add sliced onion and cucumber and toss gently.

stages.title: Combine and rest
steps: Fold bread and torn basil into the tomato mixture.
Rest for ten to fifteen minutes so the bread absorbs the dressing but retains bite.

tips: Use the ripest tomatoes available.
variations: Add capers or olives.
storage: Best eaten same day; refrigerate up to 1 day.

title: American Macaroni and Cheese
summary: Tender macaroni folded into a velvety cheddar sauce beneath a golden breadcrumb crust.

stages.title: Cook the pasta
steps: Boil macaroni in salted water until two minutes shy of al dente.
Drain well; it will finish cooking in the oven.

stages.title: Make cheese sauce
steps: Melt butter, whisk in flour and cook one minute without browning.
Gradually whisk in milk until thick, then remove from heat and stir in cheeses and mustard.

stages.title: Assemble the bake
steps: Fold pasta through the cheese sauce until evenly coated.
Transfer to a buttered baking dish and sprinkle breadcrumbs over the top.

stages.title: Bake until bubbling
steps: Bake at 190°C until golden and bubbling around the edges.
Rest five minutes before serving so the sauce settles.

tips: Grate cheese yourself for a smoother sauce.
variations: Add steamed broccoli before baking.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days; reheat covered with a splash of milk.

title: Japanese Tamagoyaki
summary: Soft rolled Japanese omelette with delicate layers and a lightly sweet soy-seasoned flavour.

stages.title: Mix the eggs
steps: Beat eggs gently with dashi, soy sauce, sugar and mirin.
Strain if desired for an especially smooth texture.

stages.title: Cook first layer
steps: Lightly oil a small rectangular or round non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Pour in a thin layer of egg and roll it towards one side while still slightly soft.

stages.title: Build the layers
steps: Re-oil the exposed pan and add another thin layer, lifting the roll so egg flows beneath.
Roll the cooked egg over the new layer and repeat until mixture is used.

stages.title: Shape and slice
steps: Rest the omelette briefly, then gently press into a neat log with a clean mat if available.
Slice into thick pieces and serve warm.

tips: Keep heat moderate to prevent browned layers.
variations: Omit sugar for a savoury version.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; serve chilled or gently warmed.

title: Turkish Lentil Soup Mercimek Corbasi
summary: Velvety red lentil soup with carrot, cumin and lemon, finished with paprika butter.

stages.title: Soften the vegetables
steps: Dice onion, carrot and potato into small pieces.
Cook onion and carrot in a little oil until softened.

stages.title: Simmer lentils
steps: Add rinsed lentils, potato, cumin and stock.
Simmer until the lentils and vegetables are completely tender.

stages.title: Blend until silky
steps: Blend carefully with a stick blender until smooth.
Add hot water as needed for a pourable, velvety texture.

stages.title: Finish with butter
steps: Melt butter in a small pan and stir in paprika briefly without burning.
Drizzle over soup and serve with lemon wedges.

tips: Red lentils naturally thicken the soup as they break down.
variations: Add dried mint to the paprika butter.
storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days; freeze up to 2 months.

title: Mexican Elote
summary: Charred sweetcorn brushed with lime mayonnaise, chilli and salty crumbled cheese.

stages.title: Char the corn
steps: Grill corn over medium-high heat, turning often, until kernels are tender and spotted with char.
Alternatively roast under a hot oven grill, turning frequently.

stages.title: Make the crema
steps: Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and lime juice until smooth.
Taste and add a pinch of salt if needed.

stages.title: Coat the cobs
steps: Brush hot corn generously with the creamy dressing.
Roll in crumbled cheese so it sticks to the surface.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Dust lightly with chilli powder and scatter coriander.
Serve immediately with extra lime wedges.

tips: Charred spots give elote its signature smoky flavour.
variations: Cut kernels off the cob for esquites-style cups.
storage: Best eaten fresh; refrigerate cooked corn up to 2 days.

title: Indian Chicken Biryani
summary: Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced chicken, caramelised onions, saffron and fresh mint.

stages.title: Marinate chicken
steps: Mix chicken with yoghurt, ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala and turmeric.
Refrigerate for at least thirty minutes while preparing rice and onions.

stages.title: Parboil rice
steps: Rinse and soak basmati rice briefly, then boil in salted water until about seventy percent cooked.
Drain promptly so grains remain firm enough to finish steaming.

stages.title: Layer the biryani
steps: Fry sliced onions until deeply golden and cook marinated chicken until nearly cooked through.
Layer chicken, rice, onions, mint and saffron-infused milk in a heavy pot.

stages.title: Steam and rest
steps: Cover tightly and cook on very low heat until chicken is cooked through and rice tender.
Rest covered ten minutes, then fluff gently without crushing the grains.

tips: Keep rice slightly undercooked before layering.
variations: Add boiled eggs and toasted cashews.
storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly.

title: Spanish Tortilla de Patatas
summary: Thick Spanish omelette with tender potatoes and sweet onions bound in softly set eggs.

stages.title: Slice the potatoes
steps: Peel potatoes and slice thinly and evenly.
Slice onion into thin half-moons.

stages.title: Cook gently in oil
steps: Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan and add potatoes and onion.
Cook gently until completely tender without becoming crisp, then drain excess oil.

stages.title: Combine with eggs
steps: Beat eggs with salt in a large bowl and fold in warm potatoes.
Rest five minutes so the potatoes absorb some egg.

stages.title: Set and turn
steps: Pour mixture into a lightly oiled non-stick skillet and cook over medium-low heat until edges set.
Invert carefully onto a plate, slide back and cook until the centre reaches your preferred doneness.

tips: Cook potatoes gently rather than frying them crisp.
variations: Add roasted red peppers.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days; serve chilled or reheated.

title: Middle Eastern Baba Ganoush
summary: Smoky roasted aubergine blended with tahini, lemon and garlic for a silky dip.

stages.title: Char the aubergines
steps: Prick aubergines and roast at 220°C until skins collapse and flesh is very soft.
For a smokier flavour, char the skins over a gas flame first.

stages.title: Drain the flesh
steps: Cool until manageable, then scoop out the soft flesh.
Drain in a sieve briefly to remove excess liquid and bitterness.

stages.title: Mix the dip
steps: Mash aubergine with tahini, lemon juice, grated garlic and cumin.
Stir until creamy but still slightly textured.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Taste for salt and lemon and drizzle with olive oil.
Scatter parsley on top and serve with warm flatbread.

tips: Drain roasted aubergine to avoid a watery dip.
variations: Add a spoon of yoghurt for extra creaminess.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days in an airtight container.

title: British Eton Mess
summary: Crushed crisp meringue folded through softly whipped cream and juicy strawberries.

stages.title: Macerate berries
steps: Hull and quarter strawberries and toss with lemon juice and a little icing sugar.
Leave until they release a light syrup.

stages.title: Whip the cream
steps: Whip chilled cream with vanilla to soft peaks.
Stop before it becomes stiff or grainy.

stages.title: Fold together
steps: Crush meringues into uneven chunks, keeping some large pieces.
Fold most berries and meringue gently into the cream.

stages.title: Assemble and serve
steps: Spoon into glasses and top with reserved berries and meringue.
Serve immediately while the meringue is still crunchy.

tips: Fold meringue in at the last minute for contrast.
variations: Use raspberries instead of strawberries.
storage: Store components separately chilled up to 1 day; assemble fresh.

title: Korean Japchae
summary: Springy sweet potato noodles tossed with beef, spinach and vegetables in a glossy sesame-soy dressing.

stages.title: Cook noodles
steps: Boil sweet potato noodles until tender and pleasantly chewy.
Drain, rinse briefly and toss with a little sesame oil.

stages.title: Prepare toppings
steps: Blanch spinach, squeeze dry and season lightly.
Sauté carrot, pepper and mushrooms separately so each stays distinct.

stages.title: Cook beef
steps: Sear thin beef strips in a hot pan until cooked through.
Add garlic, soy sauce and sugar and toss briefly.

stages.title: Combine and finish
steps: Toss noodles with vegetables, beef and remaining sesame oil.
Taste for soy and sweetness and serve warm or at room temperature.

tips: Cook vegetables separately to retain their colours.
variations: Omit beef and add tofu.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days; reheat gently.

title: Mexican Sopa de Lima
summary: Light Yucatán-style chicken soup scented with lime, oregano and toasted tortilla strips.

stages.title: Cook the chicken
steps: Simmer chicken gently in stock until cooked through.
Remove and shred, keeping the broth warm.

stages.title: Build the soup
steps: Sauté chopped onion and garlic until soft, then add diced tomatoes and oregano.
Cook until tomatoes begin to break down and stir into broth.

stages.title: Crisp tortilla strips
steps: Cut tortillas into thin strips and toss with oil.
Bake at 200°C until crisp and golden, then cool on a rack.

stages.title: Finish with lime
steps: Return shredded chicken to broth and warm through.
Add lime juice off the heat and serve with tortilla strips.

tips: Add lime at the end for a fresh citrus aroma.
variations: Add sliced avocado at serving.
storage: Refrigerate soup up to 3 days; keep tortilla strips separate.

title: French Tarte Tatin
summary: Caramelised apples baked beneath buttery pastry, then turned out into a glossy upside-down tart.

stages.title: Prepare apples
steps: Peel, core and quarter apples, keeping pieces similar in size.
Toss with lemon juice to prevent browning.

stages.title: Make caramel
steps: Melt sugar in an ovenproof skillet over medium heat until amber.
Swirl in butter carefully and arrange apples snugly in the caramel.

stages.title: Cover with pastry
steps: Cook apples briefly to release some moisture, then remove from heat.
Lay pastry over apples and tuck edges inside the pan.

stages.title: Bake and invert
steps: Bake at 190°C until pastry is puffed and golden.
Rest five minutes, then invert carefully onto a large plate while caramel is still fluid.

tips: Choose firm apples that hold shape during cooking.
variations: Add a pinch of cinnamon to the caramel.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; reheat in oven.

title: Thai Coconut Rice
summary: Fluffy jasmine rice gently cooked in coconut milk with a delicate sweetness and pandan aroma.

stages.title: Rinse the rice
steps: Rinse jasmine rice gently until the water runs mostly clear.
Drain well so the liquid ratio stays accurate.

stages.title: Combine liquids
steps: Stir coconut milk, water, sugar and salt in a heavy saucepan.
Add pandan leaf if using and bring just to a gentle simmer.

stages.title: Steam the rice
steps: Add rice, cover tightly and reduce heat to very low.
Cook without lifting the lid until liquid is absorbed and rice tender.

stages.title: Rest and fluff
steps: Remove from heat and leave covered for ten minutes.
Discard pandan and fluff gently with a fork before serving.

tips: Use full-fat coconut milk for richer flavour.
variations: Add lime zest for a fresh note.
storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly.

title: Italian Caprese Salad
summary: Ripe tomatoes, fresh mozzarella and basil layered with olive oil and a little sea salt.

stages.title: Prepare tomatoes
steps: Slice ripe tomatoes into even rounds with a sharp knife.
Arrange on a plate and season lightly with sea salt.

stages.title: Slice mozzarella
steps: Drain mozzarella and pat gently to remove excess whey.
Slice into rounds similar in thickness to the tomatoes.

stages.title: Layer with basil
steps: Alternate tomatoes and mozzarella, tucking fresh basil leaves between them.
Avoid tearing basil too early to preserve its fragrance.

stages.title: Dress and serve
steps: Drizzle with good extra virgin olive oil and add freshly ground pepper.
Serve immediately at room temperature for best flavour.

tips: Use room-temperature tomatoes for fuller flavour.
variations: Add a few drops of balsamic vinegar if desired.
storage: Best eaten fresh; refrigerate leftovers up to 1 day.

title: Indian Poha
summary: Light flattened rice tossed with turmeric, mustard seeds, peanuts, curry leaves and lemon.

stages.title: Rinse the poha
steps: Rinse flattened rice briefly in a sieve until just softened.
Drain and leave to hydrate without soaking it into mush.

stages.title: Cook peanuts and spices
steps: Toast peanuts in a little oil until golden, then remove.
Add mustard seeds and curry leaves to the pan until fragrant.

stages.title: Cook vegetables
steps: Add diced potato and onion and cook until potato is tender.
Stir in chilli and turmeric for thirty seconds.

stages.title: Fold and finish
steps: Add softened poha and peanuts and toss gently until heated through.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander if available.

tips: Use thick poha; thin flakes can disintegrate.
variations: Add peas or grated coconut.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; reheat gently.

title: Greek Loukoumades
summary: Little golden fried doughnuts drizzled with honey, cinnamon and crunchy walnuts.

stages.title: Mix and prove dough
steps: Whisk flour, yeast, sugar, salt and warm water into a thick sticky batter.
Cover and leave in a warm place until visibly bubbly and doubled.

stages.title: Heat the oil
steps: Heat oil in a deep pot to about 175°C.
Prepare two teaspoons dipped in oil for shaping the batter.

stages.title: Fry doughnuts
steps: Drop small spoonfuls of batter into oil in batches without crowding.
Turn until evenly puffed and golden, then drain on a rack.

stages.title: Honey and serve
steps: Warm honey gently so it pours easily.
Drizzle over hot doughnuts and finish with cinnamon and chopped walnuts.

tips: Maintain steady oil temperature for light centres.
variations: Serve with melted dark chocolate instead of honey.
storage: Best eaten immediately; fried dough softens in storage.

title: Japanese Chicken Yakitori
summary: Chargrilled chicken skewers brushed with a glossy soy, mirin and sake glaze.

stages.title: Prepare the glaze
steps: Simmer soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar until slightly syrupy.
Set aside some clean sauce for serving and use the rest for basting.

stages.title: Thread the skewers
steps: Cut chicken into even bite-sized pieces and spring onions into short lengths.
Thread alternating pieces onto soaked bamboo skewers.

stages.title: Grill the chicken
steps: Grill over medium-high heat, turning regularly so all sides cook evenly.
Brush with glaze during the final minutes to build a shiny coating without burning.

stages.title: Rest and serve
steps: Check chicken is fully cooked through before removing from heat.
Rest briefly and brush with reserved clean glaze.

tips: Glaze near the end to prevent sugar scorching.
variations: Use mushrooms between chicken pieces.
storage: Refrigerate cooked skewers up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly.

title: Turkish Kisir
summary: Fine bulgur salad with tomato and pepper pastes, parsley, lemon and pomegranate molasses.

stages.title: Hydrate bulgur
steps: Place fine bulgur in a bowl and pour over boiling water.
Cover tightly until tender, then fluff with a fork.

stages.title: Mix the pastes
steps: Stir tomato paste and pepper paste into warm bulgur.
Work through evenly until grains turn reddish and fragrant.

stages.title: Chop vegetables
steps: Finely chop spring onions, parsley and cucumber.
Fold into cooled bulgur so herbs stay fresh.

stages.title: Dress and serve
steps: Add pomegranate molasses, olive oil and lemon juice.
Taste for tanginess and salt, then serve with lettuce leaves.

tips: Use fine bulgur, which hydrates without boiling.
variations: Add chopped walnuts for crunch.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days.

title: French Clafoutis
summary: Juicy cherries baked in a tender vanilla custard batter with a lightly golden top.

stages.title: Prepare dish and cherries
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and butter a shallow baking dish.
Spread pitted cherries evenly across the base.

stages.title: Whisk the batter
steps: Whisk eggs and sugar until combined, then add flour gradually.
Pour in milk, cream and vanilla and whisk until smooth.

stages.title: Bake gently
steps: Pour batter around cherries and bake until puffed and lightly golden.
The centre should be just set with a slight wobble, not liquid.

stages.title: Cool and serve
steps: Let clafoutis cool until warm so the custard settles.
Dust lightly with icing sugar if desired and serve in spoonfuls.

tips: Do not overbake or the custard may become rubbery.
variations: Use plums or berries instead of cherries.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; serve warm or chilled.

title: Moroccan Zaalouk
summary: Smoky aubergine and tomato dip simmered with cumin, paprika, garlic and olive oil.

stages.title: Roast aubergines
steps: Prick aubergines and roast at 220°C until collapsed and very soft.
Cool slightly and scoop flesh from the skins.

stages.title: Cook tomatoes
steps: Heat olive oil with garlic, cumin and paprika until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes and simmer until thick and jammy.

stages.title: Combine and reduce
steps: Mash aubergine flesh into the tomato sauce with a fork.
Cook uncovered, stirring, until excess moisture evaporates.

stages.title: Finish with herbs
steps: Add lemon juice and chopped coriander.
Taste for salt and serve warm or at room temperature with bread.

tips: Reduce thoroughly for a spreadable texture.
variations: Add a pinch of chilli for heat.
storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days.

title: British Welsh Rarebit
summary: Thick toast covered in sharp cheddar, mustard and ale sauce, grilled until bubbling.

stages.title: Make the base
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan and stir in flour for one minute.
Gradually whisk in ale to make a thick smooth sauce.

stages.title: Add cheese
steps: Remove from direct heat and stir in grated cheddar, mustard and Worcestershire sauce.
Mix in egg yolk once slightly cooled until smooth.

stages.title: Prepare toast
steps: Toast bread lightly on both sides so it stays firm under the topping.
Spread cheese mixture thickly to the edges.

stages.title: Grill and serve
steps: Place under a hot grill until puffed, golden and bubbling.
Allow to cool briefly before eating as the cheese is very hot.

tips: Use mature cheddar for a pronounced flavour.
variations: Replace ale with milk for an alcohol-free version.
storage: Best eaten fresh; refrigerate cheese mixture up to 1 day.

title: Indian Rava Upma
summary: Fluffy savoury semolina cooked with mustard seeds, curry leaves, vegetables and toasted cashews.

stages.title: Toast semolina
steps: Dry-toast semolina over medium-low heat until fragrant but not browned.
Transfer to a bowl so it does not continue cooking.

stages.title: Temper aromatics
steps: Heat ghee and pop mustard seeds, then add curry leaves and chilli.
Cook onion and diced carrot until slightly softened.

stages.title: Cook semolina
steps: Add water and peas and bring to a gentle boil.
Sprinkle semolina in gradually while stirring continuously to prevent lumps.

stages.title: Steam and finish
steps: Cover on low heat until water is absorbed and grains are fluffy.
Top with toasted cashews and serve with lemon wedges.

tips: Add semolina slowly while stirring to prevent clumps.
variations: Add grated ginger with the onion.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; reheat with a splash of water.

title: Mexican Tres Leches Cake
summary: Light vanilla sponge soaked in three milks and topped with softly whipped cream.

stages.title: Bake the sponge
steps: Whip eggs and sugar until pale and voluminous, then fold in flour and baking powder.
Bake in a lined dish at 175°C until golden and springy.

stages.title: Mix the milks
steps: Whisk evaporated milk, condensed milk and whole milk until combined.
Allow sponge to cool slightly, then prick all over with a skewer.

stages.title: Soak and chill
steps: Pour milk mixture slowly over the cake in several additions.
Refrigerate at least three hours until fully absorbed.

stages.title: Whip and finish
steps: Whip cream to soft peaks and spread over chilled cake.
Slice and serve cold, adding berries if desired.

tips: Pour milk gradually to avoid pooling.
variations: Add cinnamon to the milk mixture.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 3 days; do not leave unrefrigerated.

title: Greek Avgolemono Soup
summary: Silky lemon-and-egg chicken soup with tender rice and fresh dill.

stages.title: Simmer rice
steps: Bring stock to a gentle simmer and add rice and diced carrot.
Cook until rice is tender, then reduce heat to low.

stages.title: Warm chicken
steps: Add shredded cooked chicken and heat through gently.
Keep the soup below a rolling boil.

stages.title: Temper eggs
steps: Whisk eggs and lemon juice until frothy in a bowl.
Slowly whisk in several ladles of hot broth to warm the eggs without scrambling.

stages.title: Finish gently
steps: Stir tempered egg mixture back into soup off the heat.
Warm gently without boiling and finish with dill.

tips: Never boil after adding eggs or the soup may curdle.
variations: Use orzo instead of rice.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; reheat gently without boiling.

title: Lebanese Chicken Shawarma Bowls
summary: Spiced grilled chicken over rice with cucumber, tomato, pickles and garlicky yoghurt sauce.

stages.title: Marinate chicken
steps: Mix chicken with half the yoghurt, garlic, lemon, cumin, paprika and cinnamon.
Rest refrigerated while rice and vegetables are prepared.

stages.title: Cook rice and salad
steps: Rinse and cook basmati rice until fluffy.
Dice cucumber and tomatoes and season lightly with lemon.

stages.title: Grill chicken
steps: Cook chicken in a hot skillet or grill pan until charred in places and fully cooked through.
Rest five minutes before slicing across the grain.

stages.title: Assemble bowls
steps: Mix remaining yoghurt with garlic and lemon for a quick sauce.
Serve chicken over rice with salad and drizzle with sauce.

tips: Chicken thighs stay juicy under high heat.
variations: Add hummus and pickled turnips.
storage: Refrigerate cooked chicken and rice separately up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly.

title: Portuguese Caldo Verde
summary: Velvety potato soup with ribbons of kale and smoky chouriço in a garlicky broth.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Cook diced onion and garlic gently in olive oil until translucent.
Keep the pieces evenly sized so they cook at a similar rate.

stages.title: Build the base
steps: Add peeled cubed potatoes and stock, then simmer until the potatoes are very soft.
Use moderate heat to develop flavour without scorching.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Blend the potato broth until smooth and stir in finely shredded kale.
Check texture and doneness before moving to the final step.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Add sliced chouriço and simmer until kale is tender and sausage piping hot.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

tips: Read the method before starting and prepare all ingredients first.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Persian Shirazi Salad
summary: Finely diced cucumber, tomatoes and onion brightened with lime, dried mint and olive oil.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Dice cucumbers into small even cubes and place in a mixing bowl.
Keep the pieces evenly sized so they cook at a similar rate.

stages.title: Build the base
steps: Remove watery tomato cores, dice flesh and finely chop red onion.
Use moderate heat to develop flavour without scorching.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Whisk lime juice with olive oil, dried mint and a pinch of salt.
Check texture and doneness before moving to the final step.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Toss vegetables with dressing immediately before serving to preserve their crunch.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

tips: Read the method before starting and prepare all ingredients first.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: German Apple Pancake
summary: Puffed oven-baked pancake with buttery apples, cinnamon and crisp golden edges.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Preheat oven to 220°C and place a heavy ovenproof skillet inside.
Keep the pieces evenly sized so they cook at a similar rate.

stages.title: Build the base
steps: Whisk eggs, flour and milk into a smooth thin batter and let stand briefly.
Use moderate heat to develop flavour without scorching.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Melt butter in the hot skillet and arrange thinly sliced apples with cinnamon sugar.
Check texture and doneness before moving to the final step.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Pour batter over apples and bake until dramatically puffed and golden; serve immediately.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

tips: Read the method before starting and prepare all ingredients first.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Indonesian Gado Gado
summary: Blanched vegetables, tofu and eggs with a rich peanut dressing and crunchy toppings.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Boil potatoes and eggs until cooked, then cool and slice into bite-sized pieces.
Keep the pieces evenly sized so they cook at a similar rate.

stages.title: Build the base
steps: Blanch green beans and cabbage briefly so they stay vibrant and crisp.
Use moderate heat to develop flavour without scorching.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Pan-fry cubed tofu until golden on all sides and drain excess oil.
Check texture and doneness before moving to the final step.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Whisk peanut butter with lime, kecap manis and warm water; arrange ingredients and drizzle generously.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

tips: Read the method before starting and prepare all ingredients first.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Scottish Cullen Skink
summary: Creamy smoked haddock chowder with tender potatoes, leek and parsley.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Poach smoked haddock gently in milk and water until just cooked, then lift out.
Keep the pieces evenly sized so they cook at a similar rate.

stages.title: Build the base
steps: Soften sliced leek in butter without browning and add cubed potatoes.
Use moderate heat to develop flavour without scorching.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Pour in the strained poaching liquid and simmer until potatoes are soft.
Check texture and doneness before moving to the final step.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Flake fish into the soup, warm through and finish with chopped parsley.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

tips: Read the method before starting and prepare all ingredients first.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Italian Gnocchi with Brown Butter and Sage
summary: Pillowy potato gnocchi tossed in nutty browned butter with crisp sage leaves and Parmesan.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Melt butter over medium heat until the milk solids turn golden and smell nutty.
Keep the pieces evenly sized so they cook at a similar rate.

stages.title: Build the base
steps: Add sage leaves to the brown butter and cook until crisp, then remove from direct heat.
Use moderate heat to develop flavour without scorching.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Boil gnocchi until they float and transfer directly into the sage butter with a little cooking water.
Check texture and doneness before moving to the final step.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Toss gently to coat, add lemon zest and Parmesan and serve while hot.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

tips: Read the method before starting and prepare all ingredients first.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Jamaican Rice and Peas
summary: Fluffy coconut rice with kidney beans, thyme, spring onion and gentle allspice warmth.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Rinse rice thoroughly and drain to remove excess surface starch.
Keep the pieces evenly sized so they cook at a similar rate.

stages.title: Build the base
steps: Simmer coconut milk with water, thyme, spring onions and allspice for five minutes.
Use moderate heat to develop flavour without scorching.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Add rice and drained kidney beans, cover and cook on very low heat until tender.
Check texture and doneness before moving to the final step.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Rest covered for ten minutes, discard herb stems and fluff gently with a fork.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

tips: Read the method before starting and prepare all ingredients first.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: French Pear Belle Hélène
summary: Tender poached pears with warm dark chocolate sauce and vanilla ice cream.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Peel pears leaving stems intact and simmer water with sugar and vanilla.
Keep the pieces evenly sized so they cook at a similar rate.

stages.title: Build the base
steps: Poach pears gently until a knife slides in easily, then cool in the syrup.
Use moderate heat to develop flavour without scorching.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Warm cream and pour over chopped chocolate, stirring until glossy and smooth.
Check texture and doneness before moving to the final step.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Place drained pears over vanilla ice cream and drizzle with warm chocolate sauce.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

tips: Read the method before starting and prepare all ingredients first.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Chinese Tomato Egg Stir Fry
summary: Soft scrambled eggs folded into juicy tomatoes with a lightly sweet, savoury sauce.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Beat eggs with a pinch of salt and cut tomatoes into generous wedges.
Keep the pieces evenly sized so they cook at a similar rate.

stages.title: Build the base
steps: Quickly scramble eggs in hot oil until softly set, then transfer to a plate.
Use moderate heat to develop flavour without scorching.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Cook tomatoes with sugar and soy sauce until they release juices and soften.
Check texture and doneness before moving to the final step.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Return eggs to the pan, fold gently through the sauce and finish with spring onions.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

tips: Read the method before starting and prepare all ingredients first.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Mexican Arroz Rojo
summary: Fluffy tomato-red rice with onion, garlic and stock, a classic accompaniment to tacos.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Blend tomatoes, onion and garlic into a smooth sauce.
Keep the pieces evenly sized so they cook at a similar rate.

stages.title: Build the base
steps: Toast dry rice in oil over medium heat until lightly golden and nutty.
Use moderate heat to develop flavour without scorching.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Add tomato mixture carefully and cook until the raw aroma fades.
Check texture and doneness before moving to the final step.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Pour in stock and peas, cover and simmer until rice is tender; rest before fluffing.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

tips: Read the method before starting and prepare all ingredients first.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Indian Besan Chilla
summary: Golden chickpea-flour pancakes speckled with onion, coriander, chilli and cumin.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Whisk chickpea flour with water until smooth and free of lumps.
Keep the pieces evenly sized so they cook at a similar rate.

stages.title: Build the base
steps: Fold in finely chopped onion, chilli, coriander and cumin with a pinch of salt.
Use moderate heat to develop flavour without scorching.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Heat a lightly oiled skillet and spread batter into thin circles with a ladle.
Check texture and doneness before moving to the final step.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cook each side until golden and fully set, then serve hot with chutney.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving.

tips: Read the method before starting and prepare all ingredients first.
variations: Adjust seasoning and garnishes to suit your taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.
